topic: Choosing Frames after an Eye Exam

script.title: CHOOSING FRAMES AFTER AN EYE EXAM
script.story_hook: Choosing new frames after an eye exam.
script.intro_zh: 驗完眼後在眼鏡行挑選鏡框。
script.welcome_en: Hi friends, glad you're here! Today we're picking out glasses.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，謝謝你們來！今天我們來挑眼鏡。
script.outro: That's all for today! Keep listening and see you next time.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！繼續聆聽，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now listen and repeat each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一句一句聆聽並跟讀。

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👓挑鏡框英文｜描述風格・試戴鏡框・問鏡片預算｜聽完就會問｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
驗完眼，卻不知道怎么用英文挑鏡框？
試戴、漸進鏡片、預算分期，到底要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一家眼鏡行，跟著客人從描述風格、試戴鏡框，到詢問鏡片選項、預算與分期，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪞 描述與試戴：例如「round and thin」、「can I try them?」、「look in the mirror」。
🔍 詢問鏡片：例如「What's my lens option?」、「you need progressives for near and far」。
💰 談預算分期：例如「will those cost a lot more?」、「we offer payment plans」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完記得實戰一次，原來挑眼鏡可以這麼簡單！
script.thumbnail_action: holding frames up to her face

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My exam's done, now I need new frames.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɪɡˈzæmz dʌn naʊ aɪ niːd nu freɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 我檢查完了，現在需要新眼鏡框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, how would you describe your style?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ wʊd ju dɪˈskraɪb jɔr staɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好，你會怎麼形容你的風格？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something simple, maybe round and thin.
dialogue.zh: 想要簡約一點，也許圓的、細的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have these matte black ones for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðiːz mæt blæk wʌnz fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 我這有幾款霧面黑的適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh those are nice, can I try them?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðoʊz ɑr naɪs kæn aɪ traɪ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 噢那很好看，我能試戴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here you go, look in the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs hɪr ju ɡoʊ lʊk ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər/
dialogue.zh: 當然，給你，對著鏡子看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They fit well, but they feel a bit heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ fɪt wɛl bʌt ðeɪ fil ə bɪt ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 它們很合，但感覺有點重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try these titanium, they're very light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, I barely feel these at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ aɪ ˈbɛrli fil ðiːz æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 哇，我幾乎完全感覺不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pair suits your face perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 這一副非常適合你的臉型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love them. What's my lens option?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðɛm wɑts maɪ lɛnz ˈɑpʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我好喜歡。我的鏡片選項是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You need progressives for near and far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju nid prəˈɡrɛsɪvz fɔr nɪr ənd fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 你需要漸進鏡片，看近看遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Progressives, will those cost a lot more?
dialogue.phonetic: /prəˈɡrɛsɪvz wɪl ðoʊz kɔst ə lɑt mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About forty more, but they're worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈfɔrti mɔr bʌt ðɛr wɜrθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大約多四十塊，但很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My budget's tight this month, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，這個月我預算很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We offer payment plans, no interest either.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔfər ˈpeɪmənt plænz noʊ ˈɪntrəst ˈiðər/
dialogue.zh: 我們有分期方案，也沒有利息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll take the titanium pair then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl teɪk ðə taɪˈteɪniəm pɛr ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 完美，那我就拿這副鈦的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice, they'll be ready Friday!
